name: lear-golden
description: Questions about the Lear backend (aviunion1348-cloud/Lear-backend-Avi) answered from docs/lear_backend. Hand-written from reading the pinned source; every answerable case cites path:line evidence with a quote that `lear eval validate --source <checkout>` re-reads with git show. Cases are append-only; see the checksum file.

splitPolicy.calibration: threshold calibration only (abstain threshold, reranker weights)
splitPolicy.dev: diagnosis and tuning during improvement rounds
splitPolicy.test: scored for reports; never used to choose changes
splitPolicy.holdout: locked; scored once at the end with --allow-holdout

scoring.must_include: all groups required; any alternative in a group satisfies it (case-insensitive substring)
scoring.must_not_include: any hit is a failure (e.g. invented secrets)
scoring.statuses: acceptable agent statuses; preferred_status is the ideal one

cases.question: Which permission modes does the Lear permission engine support?
Can an action in the NEVER risk tier run if the user gives an explicit grant in bypass mode?

evidence.quote: It can never override the NEVER tier.

cases.question: In environment-scoped mode, what decision does a SAFE-tier action get when the target environment is production?

evidence.quote: return Decision.ALLOW if environment != PRODUCTION else Decision.PROMPT

cases.question: What does an APPROVAL-tier action need before Lear will run it, even in bypass mode?

evidence.quote: return Decision.ALLOW if grant else Decision.PROMPT
always requires an explicit per-action grant, even in bypass
